subject: encode-cpu: intended edits (after your gates finish; will not edit while your build/tests run)
body: Findings so far (source read, host): (1) tegu_owned_class (library_frontend.inc:45) does dlopen(libobjc)+3x dlsym+objc_getClass on EVERY call on device; ~10-15 calls per draw (setVertex/FragmentBuffer/Texture/Sampler, index buffer, sampler loop in generic_snapshot_rt). Fix: resolve entry points once + small lock-free class cache keyed by literal; identical semantics. (2) Rust planner tegu_air_render_pipeline_plan_generic_specialized runs full metal2vulkan plan+instantiate per draw: ~100 us host/draw = largest remaining host cost after your module digest. Fix: exact per-pipeline 4-way memo keyed on (p->compiled, canonical resource bytes excl. 4B padding, layouts, draw); only successes cached; hit returns identical plan/spec bytes. (3) setVertexBytes/setFragmentBytes allocate a GPU BO per call (newBufferWithBytes) - measuring whether CA uses it. EDITS: render_pipeline.inc: add genericPlanMemo/genericPlanMemoLock to TeguRenderPipeline, memo funcs after tegu_render_generic_variant_select, free in dealloc, invalidate in tegu_render_generic_prepare. render_encoder.inc: ONE call-site change in tegu_render_generic_snapshot_rt (inside your TEGU_ENC_PLAN scope: planner call -> tegu_render_plan_generic_cached) and add plan_hits/plan_misses to your TEGU_PERF_ENCODE line (ok?). library_frontend.inc: tegu_owned_class body only. No batching/bridge code touched.
